title: Construction Loans Credit Standards: Application, Commitment Sizing and Closing
content:
These standards govern how an application for any of the Construction Loans is registered, sized, decided and closed.

## Standard

An application is registered with the plans, the approved budget, the builder and the permanent product, and is decided by a credit officer. The commitment must lie between the product's smallest commitment and largest commitment and may not exceed the product's loan-to-cost limit of the budget or its loan-to-completed-value limit of the as-completed value, whichever is lower. The budget must carry a contingency of at least the product's contingency reserve percentage of hard costs. The builder must be on the approved builder list where the product requires an approved builder; the member may be their own builder only where the product allows an owner-builder. The site may not exceed the product's largest site in acres. Closing requires builder's risk insurance naming the association and the borrower equity required under the equity stock requirement of Member Equities & Patronage; on closing the construction end date is set the product's construction period in months after the closing date and an origination fee of the product's origination fee percentage of the commitment, not less than the product's minimum origination fee, is assessed, together with the product's plan review fee charged at application.

## The origination fee as a quantity

The origination fee is the commitment multiplied by the product's origination fee percentage, rounded to the cent, or the product's minimum origination fee where that minimum is the higher of the two.

## Conditions at a glance

| Stage | Requirement |
|---|---|
| Application | Plans, approved budget, builder and permanent product registered; plan review fee charged |
| Sizing | Commitment between the product's smallest and largest commitment |
| Sizing | Commitment no more than the lower of the loan-to-cost ceiling on the budget and the loan-to-completed-value ceiling on the as-completed value |
| Budget | Contingency of at least the contingency reserve percentage of hard costs |
| Builder | On the approved builder list where required; member as own builder only where allowed |
| Site | No larger than the product's largest site |
| Closing | Builder's risk insurance naming the association; borrower equity under the equity stock requirement |

## Decision and status

A registered application is in applied status. When the construction loan closes, with the builder's contract and plans approved, it becomes active and construction may begin. When the credit decision is a decline, it becomes declined.

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs)

*Sizing ceiling.* For an approved budget of USD 500,000, an as-completed appraised value of USD 520,000 and illustrative ceilings of 85 percent of cost and 80 percent of value: 85 percent of the budget is USD 425,000 and 80 percent of the value is USD 416,000; the lower, USD 416,000, is the most the commitment may be, subject also to the product's smallest and largest commitment.

*Origination fee.* With an illustrative percentage of 0.75 and minimum of USD 750, a commitment of USD 90,000 gives USD 675.00, below the minimum, so the fee is USD 750.00. With an illustrative 1.0 percent, a commitment of USD 400,000 gives USD 4,000.00, above any USD 750 minimum, so the fee is USD 4,000.00.

*Construction end date.* With an illustrative 12-month construction period, a loan closing on 15 April has its construction end date on 15 April of the following year.
